Original notes compiled from many introductory statistics resources and from my years of experience teaching this subject both as a TA at UCLA and as a private instructor and tutor. These notes do not follow a particular textbook, but they contain all of the core material that is relevant for AP Statistics students and college students taking a "first" statistics class alike.
